scope: Seulement neuf PNG staged et ce manifeste; aucun canonique, source, profil, UI, BDD, script ou regle modifie.
generationMethod: Built-in image_gen.imagegen exclusivement. Neuf generations finales neuves sans reference jointe, avec descriptions precises des anciens PNG reels inspectes; workflow explicitement autorise par le parent apres le meme probleme MINERO. Deux essais initiaux HUMAIN/NAIN avec reference jointe ont produit RGB/damier et restent traces en priorAttempts. Total11 appels, aucune extraction algorithmique ni retouche manuelle. Les neuf sorties natives finales sont copiees bit pour bit.
referencePolicy: Les NEUF anciens PNG reels de l'archive ont ete vus via view_image avant toute generation et hashes. References ordonnees par asset, usage et transmission au generateur indiques explicitement. Ne pas confondre source inspectee et fichier reference transmis a un appel final.
validationMethod: Inspection view_image de chaque sortie, lecture technique Sharp du PNG/alpha, bbox alpha>=128, pixels transparents, marges, hash SHA256; vignettes90px sur #f4f5f6 et #20252b composees uniquement en memoire. Residus alpha <=1/255 au bord notes sans falsifier les mesures.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW richly painted, sculpted metallic fantasy race emblem for Kalistar. Genuine transparent PNG background with a real alpha channel, isolated complete object, no pictured backdrop. Rich embossed silver and copper craftsmanship, deeply modelled planes, chiseled edges, high-contrast dark metal recesses, sharp painted light on polished silver, warm copper highlights, race-specific colored materials. Detailed painted fantasy game insignia, NOT a flat ivory symbol, not a vector pictogram, not a minimal icon, not a photo or plastic 3D render. Broad readable masses and strong focal features at 90px, subordinate detail that does not dissolve into microscopic filigree. The card's own round socket supplies the frame: NO extra circle, disk, medallion, square, shield backing, plinth, scenery, cast shadow, text or watermark. Center the complete emblem on a square PNG canvas, keep approximately 10 percent transparent margins, never crop the extremities. HUMAIN: ONE complete natural adult human standing with both arms hanging relaxed beside the body, one head, two hands, two separate legs and feet, adult anatomical proportions about seven and a half heads tall. Slight natural contrapposto, three-quarter orientation looking left, short wavy brown hair and an uncovered believable calm human face, no mask or helmet. Rich painted sculpted silver-and-copper traveler emblem: fitted neutral fabric garments under modest chiseled silver shoulder and forearm armor, copper edging, dark blue waist cloth, believable adult body not exaggerated heroic muscles. Exactly one person, no cape, weapon, stick, prop or base. The source art direction is a historical silver/copper fantasy helmet emblem with luminous faceted silver planes, dark recesses, warm copper inlaid borders and a few substantial laurel details; translate that craftsmanship to the entire natural human figure while completely omitting its helmet-mask, crown and laurel frame. Painted material volume and realistic adult anatomy, not photoreal skin, not a white featureless statue or stick figure. Full figure including hair and feet must fit within 80-84 percent of canvas HEIGHT, centered with generous transparent margins, do not widen human proportions to fill the square. The EMPTY background is real alpha transparency, no checkerboard, no color fill.
